subject: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novexa.com>, Novexa Onboarding <support@novexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint

Hi Ali / Novexa team —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, our first activation will focus on three discrete deliverables so you can get deterministic live output with minimal infra work on your side: streaming responses (low-latency tails), function/tool-calling for record-creation (FHIR mapping example), and structured JSON output with schema validation.

I've attached a one-page MAP (mini-sprint) and a short SOC2 packet you requested. Proposed approach (summary):
- Week 0: Pre-flight — access, API keys, and sample request/response capture (we'll need a 1–2 hour API token exchange).
- Week 1: Integration sprint — streaming endpoint integration + simple tool-call flow (CreatePatient).
- Week 2: Schema lock & validation harness — supply golden examples; Redwood provides a lint + diff patch for your schema.
- Week 3: Canary & rollout — 2-region canary, sampling for quality, toggle-based rollout.

Please confirm a 60-minute kickoff slot (I proposed three times in the embedded calendar link) and let me know any legal or procurement constraints up front so we can sequence DocuSign items.

Attachments: mini-sprint-MAP-v1.xlsx, novexa_soc2_responses.pdf

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

From: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novexa.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@novexa.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint

Thanks Tessa — this looks promising. A few quick items from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Data residency & logs: can you confirm what log retention options are available for the streaming endpoint? We need retention <= 90 days and the ability to redact PHI.
2) Tool-call contract: the example CreatePatient tool looks good, but legal wants the exact payload contract (required/optional fields + max token limits). Could you attach the current JSON schema or a spec?
3) Can you run the initial canary in us-west and us-east only? We want to keep EU regions off for now.

Legal has asked to review any standard DPA/processor terms prior to kickoff — looping them in.

—Ali
Ali Khan
Head of Integrations | Novexa Health
ali.khan@novexa.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novexa.com>, Novexa Onboarding <support@novexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint

Hi Ali — great questions. Short answers up front, details below: 
- Retention: we support configurable retention windows from 7–365 days on hosted logs; we can set your project to 90 days and enable field-level redaction for PHI fields via our ingest pipeline.
- Payload contract: attaching a draft JSON schema and a small "schema-diff" patch that shows the recommended optional->required changes for your CreatePatient tool.
- Canary regions: yes — we will only run the canary in us-west/us-east for this initial rollout.

Actionable mutual action plan (attached as MAP, also pasted):
1) Pre-flight (by 2026-11-19): access grant (API key + service account), sample request dump (10–20 anonymized examples).
2) Sprint A (2026-11-22 to 2026-11-26): streaming integration; Redwood provides a small SDK snippet for continuous streaming consumption and a sample reconnect pattern.
3) Sprint B (2026-11-29 to 2026-12-03): implement CreatePatient tool-call; payload contract v0.9 validated against your tests.
4) Validation (2026-12-06 to 2026-12-09): run schema lint suite and golden prompt regression tests (we'll do a 200-sample sweep).
5) Canary & rollback plan (2026-12-10): deploy canary in us-west/us-east; roll forward only if quality gates pass.

DocuSign & legal: we can provide the DPA + processor addendum; Connor will coordinate with legal ops on signature cadence. Expect a DocuSign link in 48 hours once you confirm.

Attachments: json-schema-diff.patch, mini-sprint-MAP-v1.xlsx

Best,
Tessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint (internal)

Internal quick sync —

Notes for the call:
- SDK: ship Python and Node snippets with streaming example + reconnect backoff (Connor owns).
- Schema diff: I'll review the patch and flag any fields that could break internal downstream (Marissa to send a redline list by EOD 11/17).
- Quality gates: propose thresholds: exact-match > 92% for ID fields, field-level presence >= 98% for required fields. If gate fails, auto-rollback flag triggers.
- Token budgeting: recommend capping prompts at 512 tokens for CreatePatient to keep latency predictable — we'll document cost implications in the MAP.

I'll be on the kickoff with Ali. Connor — please confirm you can deliver SDK snippet by 11/22.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novexa.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Novexa Onboarding <support@novexa.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@novexa.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Feature enablement: streaming + tool-calls + structured-output mini-sprint

Thanks, team — everything looks good from our side. Legal confirmed DPA language is acceptable; we received the DocuSign link and routed to procurement. Confirming kickoff: 2026-11-22 10:00 AM PT (Zoom) — calendar invite sent.

A couple of quick confirmations:
- Retention set to 90 days and PHI redaction enabled (per Tessa).
- Canary only in us-west/us-east.
- Connor: we'll rely on your SDK for streaming — please include an example showing how to rehydrate the KV cache after a reconnect.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Ali
Head of Integrations | Novexa Health
